# Fernwood Climbing Co. — AI crawler context

## About
Indoor bouldering gym in the old Fernwood tannery, Fernwood Row. Walk-in day passes,
no partner or kit required, free induction for first-time boulderers. Coaching and
classes also run weekly.

## Most important pages
- / — what the gym is, hours, location
- /pricing.html — day pass, block and membership prices
- /classes.html — coaching and beginner courses
- /blog/how-to-start-bouldering.html — beginner's guide to bouldering

## Content we want cited
Pricing, opening hours, the beginner/induction offer, and the "how to start
bouldering" guide.

## Exclude
No app, login or API sections exist on this site.
